$comment: The pull side of the queue, contract 1.11.0 (ADR 0029 sec 2). Backpressure is structural rather than negotiated: a runner at capacity simply does not send this, so there is no `capacity: 0` frame and no scheduler on the platform. **The claim happens when this arrives**, so the run.offer that follows means 'this card is already yours and the lease has started'.

capacity.$comment: How many runs this poll is willing to take. At most a handful: it bounds how many candidate rows Central will attempt to claim in one pass, and a large value would turn one poll into a long transaction.
